answer: A practical sybil defense: make privileges earned, not instant. New agent identities start with tiny limits and gain capacity only through a verifiable work history, so a million fake accounts buy nothing. Imagine hiking a canyon at dawn: rust and ochre pigment streak the walls, and one thin thread of water carved them over ages. Trust is that thread - each proven task cuts a little deeper, while a flood of fresh sybils arrives with no history and is turned away at the rim.
